name: Clio Intake Sync

parameters.content:
## Clio Intake Sync

### How it works

1. The workflow triggers when a new intake form is submitted and validates the intake data.
2. It searches for existing contacts in Clio and either selects the existing contact or creates a new one.
3. Creates a matter in Clio linked to the contact and handles success or failure outcomes.
4. On successful matter creation, it notifies staff via email and optionally Slack, and also sends a client confirmation email after compliance checks.
5. If errors occur during processing or workflow execution, it notifies staff accordingly.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure the webhook trigger to receive intake form submissions.
- [ ] Set up Clio API credentials and base URL in workflow variables.
- [ ] Provide Slack webhook URL if Slack notifications are desired.
- [ ] Configure email credentials for sending notifications and confirmations.
- [ ] Ensure the compliance guardrail sub-workflow is available and correctly referenced.

### Customization

Customize the email notification templates and Slack message content in the respective code nodes. Adjust the compliance workflow and branching logic as needed for firm policies.

## Trigger and intake validation

Handles the reception of new intake form data via webhook and validates and normalizes the payload.

## Clio contact lookup and decision

Searches Clio for existing contacts and determines if a matching contact exists, branching based on presence.

## Existing contact handling

Processes and prepares the existing contact ID for further matter creation.

## New contact creation

Creates a new contact in Clio and extracts the new contact ID for use in matter creation.

## Matter creation and response

Creates a new matter in Clio, then routes workflow based on success or failure of the creation.

## Staff notification on success

Builds and sends project manager notification emails and optionally sends Slack alerts about the new intake.

## Client confirmation message flow

Builds client confirmation messages, invokes compliance checks, and sends confirmation emails or skips based on compliance.

## Error notification on failure

Builds error payloads and notifies staff of Clio failures, then responds to the form with errors.

## Unhandled workflow error handling

Trigger for any unhandled workflow errors and notification to staff of such failures.

nodes.name: When New Client Intake Form Submitted
nodes.notes:
Entry point — point your Fluent Forms webhook feed at this URL. Expected form fields (adjust names in the next node if your form labels differ):
  full_name, email, phone, matter_type, case_details, referral_source (optional)

Activate the workflow, then open this node and copy the Production URL from the panel on the right.

nodes.name: Validate And Normalize Intake Data
nodes.notes:
Required fields: full_name, email, matter_type. Phone and case_details are optional but recommended.
Throws a descriptive error (caught downstream by the Error Trigger) if a required field is missing, so a bad form submission never silently creates a broken Clio record.

nodes.name: Fetch Existing Clio Contact
nodes.notes:
Dedupe check — searches Clio contacts by email before creating a new one.
Set CLIO_BASE_URL in project → Variables (https://app.clio.com, or https://eu.app.clio.com for EU firms).
Credential: Header Auth named 'Clio API (Bearer token)' — in Clio go to Settings → API Keys → New API key, then in n8n set the header Name to 'Authorization' and Value to 'Bearer YOUR_TOKEN'.
If this call errors (e.g. Clio rate limit), the workflow continues and treats it as 'not found' rather than blocking the whole intake — a duplicate contact is a smaller problem than a lost lead.

nodes.name: Determine If Contact Exists
nodes.notes: Runs safely even if the Clio search above errored or returned zero rows — 'no data' is treated as 'contact does not exist'.

nodes.name: If Contact Exists In Clio
nodes.notes:
Yes → reuse existing_contact_id, skip creation.
No → create a new Clio contact from the intake fields.

nodes.name: Extract Existing Contact Id
nodes.notes: Contact already exists in Clio — no duplicate is created. Forwards existing_contact_id as contact_id for the Matter step.

parameters.jsCode:
const input = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { ...input, contact_id: input.existing_contact_id } }];

nodes.name: Create New Clio Contact
nodes.notes: Creates a new Person contact in Clio. If this call fails, execution routes to the error-notification branch below rather than silently dropping the lead.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { type: 'Person', name: $json.full_name, email_addresses: [{ address: $json.email, name: 'Work' }], phone_numbers: $json.phone ? [{ number: $json.phone, name: 'Mobile' }] : [] } }) }}

nodes.name: Extract New Contact Id
nodes.notes: Throws loudly if Clio didn't return a usable contact id — this stops the run and surfaces in the Error Trigger rather than creating a Matter with no linked contact.

nodes.name: Create New Matter In Clio
nodes.notes: Both the 'existing contact' and 'new contact' branches above feed into this node — only one branch fires per run, so no Merge node is needed. Creates the Matter linked to contact_id, with practice_area mapped from the form's matter_type.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { client: { id: $json.contact_id }, practice_area: { name: $json.practice_area }, description: $json.case_details || ($json.full_name + ' — ' + $json.practice_area), status: 'Open' } }) }}

nodes.name: If Matter Creation Successful
nodes.notes:
Yes → matter has a real Clio object, proceed to staff notification.
No → Clio rejected the request (e.g. unknown practice area name) — route to error notification instead of pretending success.

nodes.name: Build PM Notification Message
nodes.notes: Builds a plain routing summary for staff — name, contact info, practice area, matter link. Deliberately contains no legal assessment or screening language (ABA Op. 512 — operational only).

nodes.name: Send Staff Email Notification
nodes.notes:
Emails the PM/staff a plain routing summary the moment a Matter is created — no legal opinion, just who, what, and a link to the record.

Credential: project → Credentials → New → SMTP, saved as 'Email account (SMTP)'. Works with Gmail app passwords, Outlook 365, Zoho, or any SMTP provider.

Set FIRM_FROM_EMAIL and FIRM_EMAIL in project → Variables (can be the same address).

parameters.subject: =New intake routed to Clio: {{ $json.full_name }}

nodes.name: If Slack Webhook Configured
nodes.notes:
Checks whether the optional Slack alert is configured.

Yes (FIRM_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL is set) → also post the intake summary to Slack.
No (variable is blank) → skip silently. The staff email alert has already been sent regardless.

To enable: Slack → your workspace → Apps → Incoming Webhooks → Add New Webhook → choose a channel → copy the URL → paste into FIRM_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL in project → Variables.

nodes.name: Post Slack Alert To Staff
nodes.notes:
Posts the same routing summary to Slack via your Incoming Webhook URL.

Setup: Slack → your workspace → Apps → Incoming Webhooks → Add New Webhook → choose a channel → copy the URL → paste into FIRM_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL in project → Variables.

If Slack returns an error (e.g. the webhook was revoked), the workflow continues — the staff already received the email alert.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ ({ text: 'New intake routed to Clio: ' + $json.full_name, blocks: [{ type: 'section', text: { type: 'mrkdwn', text: '*New Intake Routed to Clio*
*Name:* ' + $json.full_name + '
*Email:* ' + $json.email + '
*Phone:* ' + ($json.phone || '_not provided_') + '
*Practice area:* ' + $json.practice_area + '
*Matter:* ' + $vars.CLIO_BASE_URL + '/nc/#/matters/' + $json.matter_id } }] }) }}

nodes.name: Skip Slack Notification
nodes.notes: FIRM_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL is not set — Slack alert skipped. The staff email alert has already been sent. Add FIRM_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL to project → Variables to enable Slack pings.

nodes.name: Build Client Confirmation Message
nodes.notes: Purely operational acknowledgement — no legal advice, no case assessment. To send by SMS instead, set channel: 'sms' and recipient: d.phone here.

nodes.name: Execute Bar Compliance Check
nodes.notes:
Calls the shared Bar-Compliance Guardrail workflow (OPS1) — checks opt-out status and appends the required disclaimer before any client-facing message goes out.

Set GUARDRAIL_WORKFLOW_ID in project → Variables to the numeric ID from the guardrail workflow's URL: .../workflow/WORKFLOW_ID.

Passes: channel, recipient, message, template_id ('PAC-20'), matter_id.
Returns: approved (bool), message_out (disclaimer-appended text), suppression_reason.

Prerequisite: Bar-Compliance Guardrail must be deployed and active.

nodes.name: If Compliance Approved
nodes.notes:
Yes → send the confirmation using message_out (carries the required disclaimer).
No → recipient is opted out or compliance check failed — do not send, no error raised.

nodes.name: Send Confirmation Email
nodes.notes: Credential: 'Email account (SMTP)' — same credential used for the staff alert above. Sends message_out, never the raw draft — that's the version with the opt-out disclaimer attached.

nodes.name: Skip Confirmation Email
nodes.notes: Recipient is opted out (or the compliance check errored) — no confirmation sent. Visible in execution history for audit.

nodes.name: Respond Success To Intake Form
nodes.notes: Returns a small JSON success payload to Fluent Forms' webhook feed — useful if you show a custom confirmation state on the form.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'success', contact_id: $('If Matter Creation Successful').first().json.data.client.id, matter_id: $('If Matter Creation Successful').first().json.data.id } }}

nodes.name: Build Error Response Payload
nodes.notes: Only reached when Clio rejects the Matter creation request (e.g. bad practice_area name, expired token).

parameters.jsCode:
const err = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { error_summary: 'Intake sync: Clio matter creation failed. Check the Clio API response for details.', raw: err } }];

nodes.name: Send Clio Failure Notification
nodes.notes: Alerts staff by email when Clio rejects the Matter creation request, so the lead still gets a human follow-up.

nodes.name: Respond Error To Intake Form
nodes.notes: Returned to Fluent Forms if Clio matter creation failed — still a graceful message to the client, not a raw error.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'error', message: 'We could not process your submission automatically — our team has been notified and will follow up directly.' } }}

nodes.name: When Workflow Error Occurs
nodes.notes: Catches any unhandled exception anywhere in this workflow (e.g. the validation node's thrown errors) and emails staff — a safety net on top of the explicit error branch.

nodes.name: Notify Staff Of Workflow Error
nodes.notes: Safety-net alert — fires for any error not already caught by the explicit Clio-failure branch.

parameters.text: ={{ 'Unhandled error in the Clio Intake Sync workflow: ' + $json.execution.error.message }}
parameters.subject: Intake sync workflow error

description: Writes a clean Clio Contact and Matter from a Fluent Forms intake submission — no retyping. Dedupes by email, notifies staff, and optionally sends a compliance-gated client confirmation. Replaces manual data entry from web forms into Clio.
